t: Highly versatile, acrylic-based adhesive. Cures to form a strong and durable bond for interior projects. Almost odourless. Bonds wood, chipboard, hardboard and PVCu to brickwork, stone and concrete. Perfect adhesion, without use of a primer, on most (even slightly damp) substrates. Paintable with water-based and synthetic paints. Easy to apply and clean. Non-corrosive towards metals.
